abs-bing-1.webp.zh: 从机场道路望向航站楼：低矮的候机楼与塔台掩映在树丛中，四周是沙漠。
abs-bing-1.webp.en: The airport seen from its access road: a low terminal and tower among trees, desert on every side.

abs-bing-3.webp.zh: 航站楼屋顶的「ABU SIMBEL AIRPORT」标牌，下方墙面上是古埃及风格的壁画。
abs-bing-3.webp.en: The 'ABU SIMBEL AIRPORT' sign on the terminal roof, above a wall painted with ancient-Egyptian style murals.
